title: Aggregate Disambiguation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.30805v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural-language tasks can elicit different verdicts from protocol-following evaluators that receive the same declared information. We study aggregate disambiguation systems (ADSs). Given a task and a candidate solution, each evaluator casts a binary vote on whether the solution should be accepted, and the system aggregates the votes of a finite panel. The target is protocol reproducibility relative to an explicitly declared evaluator reference, not semantic truth. We separate fixed finite censuses, probabilistic evaluator populations, and growing-census limits, since their endpoint laws and guarantees are not interchangeable. In the population setting, we use finite samples to estimate how often a finite panel reaches the same decision as the declared evaluator population. translated_abstract: 自然语言任务可能会使遵循协议的评估者在接收相同声明信息的情况下给出不同的判定结果。我们研究聚合消歧系统（ADS）。给定一个任务和一个候选解，每个评估者对是否接受该解投出二元票，系统聚合有限评估小组的投票。其目标是以显式声明的评估者参考为基准的协议可复现性，而非语义真值。我们区分了固定有限普查、概率评估者总体和增长普查极限，因为它们的端点定律和保证是不可互换的。在总体设定中，我们使用有限样本来估计有限评估小组与声明的评估者总体达成相同决策的频率。我们为不一致概率至多不超过所选容差的候选解所占比例提供了置信下界。
tldr: 该论文提出聚合消歧系统（ADS），通过聚合有限评估小组对候选解的二元投票，以显式声明的评估者参考为基准研究协议可复现性，并为不一致概率不超过给定容差的候选解比例提供了置信下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes aggregate disambiguation systems (ADSs) that aggregate binary votes from a finite panel of protocol-following evaluators, targeting protocol reproducibility relative to a declared evaluator reference rather than semantic truth, and provides a lower confidence bound on the fraction of candidate solutions whose disagreement probability is within a chosen tolerance.
